name: Pyay

queries.query: Pyay Myanmar cadastral map parcel official land records; site:gov.mm Pyay cadastral land map
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Myanmar's Settlement and Land Records Department (SLRD), its official English site, the official SLRD government-websites directory, and the Department of Agriculture Land Use Division Pyay page. No anonymous Pyay parcel-vector service was identified.

queries.result: First-party Burmese discovery identified SLRD Burmese material describing Form 105 certified maps and Form 106 parcel history, plus the official Land Use Division site. The material evidences records and procedures, not an anonymous Pyay parcel geometry endpoint.

registryEvidence.custodian: Myanmar Settlement and Land Records Department (SLRD), Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Irrigation; national cadastral/land-record custodian evidenced by the official department site.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The official SLRD sources evidence national land-record and cadastral-map custody and Burmese descriptions of Form 105/106 records. No Pyay municipal registry office, open parcel API, or citywide public geometry coverage was evidenced. The Land Use Division Pyay page is a local agricultural land-use office page, not proof of an urban cadastral parcel API.

officialSources.observation: Official SLRD English landing page identifies the Settlement and Land Records Department and HQ contact context, but direct retrieval was Cloudflare-challenged.
Official Burmese SLRD result describes land-record Form 105 certified maps and Form 106 parcel history; direct anonymous GET returned HTTP 403/Cloudflare challenge.
Official SLRD government-websites directory was found in discovery; direct anonymous GET returned HTTP 403/Cloudflare challenge.

First-party Department of Agriculture Land Use Division page for Pyay returned HTTP 200 and identifies the Pyay office/page, but contains no cadastral parcel layer, public map API, schema, CRS, or safe native parcel identity.
Public first-party WordPress JSON for the Pyay page returned HTTP 200; it is page content only and contains no parcel-vector response.
